searchText: MSRP $221,535. New 2026 Grand Design Lineage VT LVT1 Features Exterior Awning Overhead Cabinets All-Wheel Drive Spare Tire Carrier Power Package Starlink Internet Tuned Falcon Adjustable Rear Shocks More About This RV This luxury motorhome for the modern adventurer will be your favorite! The flip-up bed provides a comfortable sleeping area, perfect for restful nights on the road. The entertainment spot is provided in the motorized projector screen, which is ideal for movie nights, sporting events, or presentations, making it a great way to unwind or entertain friends and family. The bathroom provides a private and convenient space for personal needs, and the kitchen features an undermount cooktop, perfect for preparing your favorite meals, 3.2 cu. ft. refrigerator for keeping perishables fresh, and a sink for easy cleanup. The exterior awning provides shade and protection from the elements, while the sliding door offers easy access and added convenience. Immerse yourself in the ultimate travel experience with our stunning Grand Design Lineage Series VT Class B motorhomes, built on the robust Ford W2XC T350 chassis. These motorhomes are equipped with a 3.5L V6 engine, providing the perfect balance of power and efficiency. You can stay connected and powered up on the go with our 400-watt solar system and 30-amp power shore connection, ideal for enjoying the freedom to boondock or staying connected to the grid with ease. Inside, you will indulge in the elegance of the interior design while traveling in an at-home experience. From the comfort of your bed to the convenience of a well-equipped kitchen, every detail has been thoughtfully designed to make you feel right at home!
